drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel: Attached is our revised draft addressing withholding, search scope, production timing, and privilege logging. The draft commits to completion of production within 30 calendar days after service of the finalized responses, with a privilege log served concurrently. Please provide the numbered requests so we can finalize corresponding request-specific responses identifying any objections and the scope of withholding. These general provisions are not intended to substitute for those responses.

edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production. The provisions below govern production and will be accompanied by separately numbered responses corresponding to each request before service.
edits.name: Preliminary statement

edits.text: 1. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES AND WITHHOLDING. Defendant will state any objection separately in its response to the particular request, identify the grounds with specificity, and state whether responsive material is being withheld on that basis. If an objection applies only to part of a request, the response will identify the excluded scope and Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged material within the remaining scope. No blanket objection applies to every request.
edits.name: Specific objections

edits.text: 2. SEARCH AND PRODUCTION. Defendant will conduct reasonable searches of all custodians and sources reasonably likely to contain responsive material, including relevant email accounts, shared repositories, and other relevant electronically stored information and paper files, consistent with applicable discovery obligations. Defendant will identify in the corresponding response any limitation on a search and its basis. Defendant will complete production of responsive, non-privileged documents within 30 calendar days after service of these finalized responses. Any extension requires written agreement or court order.
edits.name: Search scope and production deadline

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Concurrently with completion of production, Defendant will serve a privilege log identifying each responsive document withheld or redacted on privilege or work-product grounds, except as otherwise agreed in writing or permitted by applicable rule or court order. The log will identify the document date, type, author, recipients and their roles where relevant, a description of the subject matter sufficient to assess the claim without revealing protected information, and the specific privilege or protection asserted and its basis.
edits.name: Privilege log

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will timely supplement its responses and production as required by applicable rules or court order. This obligation does not extend the production deadline stated above.
edits.name: Supplementation
